=== Day 1: the town meeting ===
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it longer. I am the Surveyor."
Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Docks shares the same alignment."  [case board: #23, #24]
Merrin: "Let the heavens bear witness before the fiend strikes me down in my bed—I am the Rumormonger!"
Merrin: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Lian and Nisha is Marked, and may read as evil."  [case board: #25, #26]
Nisha: "It isn't a locked deduction yet, still—my read on Fenwick isn't clean."  [case board: #27]
Fenwick: "Friends and neighbors, the hour calls for a grand unveiling! I am the Dowser!"
Fenwick: "This afternoon, on the Docks I sensed 2 evil among Nisha, Hollis, Merrin."
Fenwick: "Friends, my instincts seldom miss a sour note, and Hollis rings false to me!"

Merrin: "Beware Hollis, good neighbors, before it's too late! Fenwick's reading on the Docks found 2 evil souls in a crowd that included them."  [case board: #32]

Greta: "You missed something, outsider: From my window, I saw Constance out in the street last night."  [case board: #68]

Lian: "I back Hollis's read on Merrin. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #70, #71]

Lian: "Putting Merrin to the vote. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."
Lian: "Review the facts already out: Fenwick's reading on the Docks found 2 evil souls in a crowd that included them."
Merrin: "Your case rests on where I was last night, so hear it from me."

Merrin: "Fenwick's reading cast a shadow over several souls! My own soul is spotless, so turn your dreadful gaze upon Nisha and Hollis!"  [case board: #73]
